Count enrolled students by arbitrary grouping dimensions

Source: R/01_trend_enrollment.R
compute_enrollment_counts.Rd

Deduplicates records to unique student-year combinations (or student-year-subject when SUBJECT is in by) before counting, so students tested in multiple subjects in the same year are not double-counted in cross-sectional tallies.

Usage

compute_enrollment_counts(data, by = NULL, assessment_spec, min_n = 10)

Arguments

data

A long-format student results data frame (see data contract). Must contain STUDENT_ID and YEAR.

by

Character vector of grouping column names, or NULL for an overall total. Supported values: "YEAR", "GRADE", "SUBJECT", demographic column names (e.g. "RACE_ETHNICITY", "FRL"), "SCHOOL_ID", "DISTRICT_ID", and their _NAME equivalents.

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

min_n

Integer. Year-over-year change columns are suppressed (set to NA) for rows where N < min_n. Default 10.

Value

A data frame with the columns in by plus:

  • N — count of unique student-year (or student-year-subject) records

  • N_change — year-over-year change in N (only when YEAR is in by)

  • N_pct_change — percent change (only when YEAR is in by)

  • suppressed — logical; TRUE when N < min_n

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
compute_enrollment_counts(demo_data, by = c("YEAR", "GRADE"), assessment_spec)
} # }
